+          # so work done in a hub session only survived as a snapshot and
+          # reached the remote only when somebody remembered to push. The panel
+          # showed a runner that looked alive and produced nothing.
+          #
+          # One autopilot per repository: yomikai and zen-panel share neither a
+          # history, nor a base branch, nor a test suite, so a single
+          # repo-wide daemon would push one into the other.
+          set -u
+          AUTOSHIP="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fork/tools/auto-ship.sh"
+          mkdir -p "$HOME/.npm-hub/logs" 2>/dev/null || true
+          chmod +x "$AUTOSHIP" 2>/dev/null || true
+          ROOT="${HUB_WORK_DIR:-$HOME/hub-work}"

+            repo="$(dirname "$gitdir")"

+            [ -n "$remote" ] || continue
+            # Each repo's own default branch is its base. Hardcoding `main`
+            # would open PRs into branches that do not exist in some repos.
+            base="$(git -C "$repo" symbolic-ref --short "refs/remotes/origin/HEAD" 2>/dev/null | sed 's|^origin/||')"

+            owner="$(basename "$(dirname "$remote")")"
+            name="$(printf '%s-%s' "$owner" "$(basename "$repo")" | tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9._-' '_')"

+            nohup env \

+              GITHUB_TOKEN="${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
+              AUTOSHIP_REPO="$repo" \
+              AUTOSHIP_BASE="$base" \
+              AUTOSHIP_INTERVAL=180 \
+              bash "$AUTOSHIP" >"$HOME/.npm-hub/logs/auto-ship-$name.log" 2>&1 &
+            started=$((started + 1))
+          done
+          if [ "$started" = 0 ]; then

+# A repo cloned from GitHub often has no local suite at all, and an autopilot

+

+# verdict from anywhere, refuse. The default is permissive on purpose, but the
+# switch has to actually work or it is decoration.

+PATH="$TMP/bin:$PATH" GH_STUB_PR="$TMP/prnum" GH_STUB_CALLS="$TMP/calls" \
